Chapter 1245 - 7 Visiting (Request For Monthly Tickets)

Chapter 1245: Chapter 7 Visiting (Request for Monthly Tickets)

"This Galaxy..."

Da Fu Ancestor was shocked.

Just by observing the first timeline, he saw Lin Yuan stepping into the thirteenth tier.

And the image scene of establishing the seventh Ancient Country.

As he continued to delve deeper into the timeline, Da Fu Ancestor vaguely felt his mind trembling and immediately stopped watching.

As the first Ancestor, Da Fu Ancestor was slightly stronger than the Ancestor of Fierce Sun and could observe more timelines, seeing further into them.

At the same time, he had a sharper perception of the timelines themselves, vaguely realizing that the future of the Galaxy Venerate was incredibly terrifying, beyond his purview.

"This timeline..."

Da Fu Ancestor gathered his thoughts; a single timeline, after all, signifies nothing.

Perhaps it was his bad luck to have just seen the timeline where the Galaxy Venerate’s potential was highest.

A single timeline cannot replace true potential, since the establishment of the Six Great Ancient Countries, so many Venerates have attempted the thirteenth tier, theoretically, each Venerate has the potential to become an Ancestor.

Yet so many long years have passed.

How many have truly become Ancestors, if not just those six?

The future is filled with too many variables; being an Ancestor in just one timeline? The probability is too low, too low.

Very quickly.

Da Fu Ancestor swiftly reviewed hundreds, thousands of timelines.

"How is this possible?"

Da Fu Ancestor was incredulous. In hundreds, thousands of timelines, the Galaxy Venerate consistently stepped into the thirteenth tier, which was extremely unreasonable.

In a fleeting moment of the future, countless timelines would be born, each splitting further into countless timelines, even the tactical layouts between time beings couldn’t guarantee something would happen for sure.

Various factors would influence the outcome, along with other time beings’ influences.

But this Galaxy Venerate?

At least in the many timelines seen by Da Fu Ancestor, the other party successfully stepped into the thirteenth tier, merely a matter of time. Simply put, the act of the Galaxy Venerate entering the thirteenth tier can’t be stopped.

At least, in the timelines he witnessed, Da Fu Ancestor was unable to stop it.

"Is it personal talent? Or an external force?" Da Fu Ancestor wondered, leaning more toward it being an external force.

Relying solely on personal talent, how could one guarantee entry into the thirteenth tier? The most talented being Da Fu Ancestor had seen was the ’Abyss Dragon’, born at the start of the Source World.

This ’Abyss Dragon’, indeed, had the possibility of stepping into the thirteenth tier, but after Da Fu Ancestor entered the thirteenth tier, the timelines in which ’Abyss Dragon’ could reach the thirteenth tier were nearly cut off.

Because Da Fu Ancestor would certainly act against the ’Abyss Dragon’, their enmity was irreconcilable, set since the beginning of heaven and earth. If ’Abyss Dragon’ entered the thirteenth tier early, Da Fu Ancestor would surely die as well.

This indicates that no matter how strong the talent, one cannot guarantee stepping into the thirteenth tier, as external forces would interfere, especially suppression by a time being, is disastrous for beings below the thirteenth tier.

Time beings see through timelines, blocking all your paths of survival; your every choice is basically seen through the timeline.

But in the face of Lin Yuan.

Da Fu Ancestor felt powerless.

Because he couldn’t stop it.

Forcibly stopping would only delay the other’s entry into the thirteenth tier.

And the cost of such actions would be the Galaxy Venerate’s retaliation after entering the thirteenth tier, making Da Fu Ancestor suffer greatly; even escaping from this dimension wouldn’t shield him from the other’s pursuit.

"Perhaps it’s because my strength isn’t sufficient, the timelines I see are too few, unable to observe a timeline that deals with this Galaxy, but it’s already unimportant; this Galaxy must not be provoked."

Da Fu Ancestor thought to himself, with the development in many of the Galaxy Venerate’s timelines, it is absolutely not an enemy to oppose.

...

As Da Fu Ancestor pondered.

The Peak Venerables and Strongest Venerables of the Da Fu Ancient Country below were feeling uncommonly distressed, Ancestor’s silent demeanor clearly indicating extreme disappointment in them, leaving nothing more to say.

Indeed.

Ancestor painstakingly cultivated them, only for them to ultimately be overwhelmed by the Galaxy Venerate of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

It should be known that the Ancestor of Fierce Sun is mostly hands-off regarding the cultivation of descendants, rarely interfering, yet under such conditions, they still couldn’t surpass; these Venerates felt ashamed towards the Ancestor.

"Ancestor."

Fu Xu Venerate’s gaze was firm, and he said solemnly, "I will cultivate the Forbidden Supreme Heritage. As for the Galaxy Venerate... I am not his match now, but after cultivating the Forbidden Supreme Heritage, my strength will increase greatly, and I will challenge the Galaxy Venerate again, preventing the Ancient Country from suffering humiliation once more."

The so-called Forbidden Supreme Heritage is akin to the "Fierce Sun Heart" heritage of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, allowing a part of oneself to advance towards the thirteenth tier, thereby realizing a surge in strength.

But the reason this kind of heritage is termed ’Forbidden Supreme Heritage’ is because the dangers it poses during cultivation are too great; the "Fierce Sun Heart" requires sacrificing most of one’s own sanity as a price, and the Forbidden Supreme Heritages of other Ancient Countries are similar, some even more costly.

For this reason, almost no Peak Venerates cultivate Forbidden Heritages, even though the power boost from Forbidden Supreme Heritage far exceeds that of Supreme Heritages, no Peak Venerate is willing to cultivate them.

At the level of a Peak Venerate, one basically stands at the top of each Ancient Country, capable of aspiring to the realm of an Ancestor, and it’s entirely unnecessary to pay such a high price for a power increase.

Especially certain Forbidden Supreme Heritages, once cultivation begins, the dangers can’t be eradicated, affecting the breakthrough to that step.
